subject: Onboarding checklist: DPA, SOC2 link & PO routing for Ava Technologies
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire@avatech.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor setup — DPA and PO questions

Hi Dylan / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. We're ready to move forward but procurement at Ava needs a couple of things confirmed before we issue a PO:

- A signed DPA (we can sign your template or accept a countersigned copy)
- Confirmation of Redwood's SOC 2 report (we need a read-only link)
- Current subprocessor list (so our privacy team can scope regional restrictions)
- PO routing instructions and contact for invoice submission (we use SAP Ariba)

I've attached the Ava onboarding worksheet with our billing and tax details. Let me know if you need anything else from our side. Ideally we'd get the DPA and SOC2 link within 48 hours so our legal/procurement can issue the PO.

Thanks,
Claire Nguyen
Head of Partnerships | Ava Technologies
claire@avatech.com
[Attachment: Ava_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire@avatech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — DPA and PO questions

Hi Claire — appreciated the call. Quick checklist and next steps below:

1) DPA: attached is our current DPA template (Redwood_DPA_Template_v3.pdf). If you prefer, we can start through DocuSign — see link below.
2) SOC 2: read-only report link (production controls) -> https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSOC2-report-2028
3) Subprocessors: see short list in the SOC2 folder; I'll paste the current subprocessor roster below for convenience.
4) PO & invoicing: we accept POs via SAP Ariba or email to procurement@redwood.com. For Ariba, use Redwood supplier code RW-8821. Invoice contact: ap@redwood.com.

Subprocessor short roster (current):
- Cloud infra: NimbusCloud (us-east-1, eu-west-1)
- Monitoring: BeaconMetrics (logs/process telemetry)
- Embedding infra (managed): VectorGrid (us-central)
- Analytics: LakeviewAnalytics (aggregated, pseudonymized usage data)

Please confirm the billing address and whether Ava requires an alternate SLA or data locality commitments. If the DPA looks good, sign and upload via the DocuSign link and we'll countersign within one business day.

DocuSign (DPA): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/AVA-DPA-83472
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/83472

Attaching the DPA template for review.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Template_v3.pdf (pdf)]

From: Claire Nguyen <claire@avatech.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Apr 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — DPA and PO questions

Thanks, Dylan — this is helpful.

We completed the onboarding worksheet and attached a signed copy of the DPA draft. A couple of notes from our legal team:
- Can you confirm whether BeaconMetrics receives any cleartext customer prompt data or only aggregated telemetry?
- VectorGrid: can you confirm their EU processing location for GDPR purposes?

Attached: Signed_DPA_AvaTech.pdf and Ava_Onboarding_Form.xlsx

We'll proceed with raising the PO in Ariba as soon as we have your confirmation on the two subprocessor points above and you countersign.

Claire
[Attachment: Signed_DPA_AvaTech.pdf (pdf)]

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire@avatech.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Apr 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — DPA and PO questions

Hi Claire — thanks for the signed copy and the worksheet. Quick answers and PO path: 

- BeaconMetrics: does not receive any raw prompt text. They ingest anonymized telemetry and aggregated metrics for service health. I'll attach a short redlined statement from our security team to the SOC2 folder for your legal review.
- VectorGrid: EU processing is in eu-west-1 (Frankfurt). They are included in our subprocessor list and flow-down obligations are in section 4(b) of the DPA.

Next steps for PO:
1) Raise the PO in Ariba using supplier code RW-8821 and attach the Ava onboarding worksheet.
2) Copy procurement@redwood.com on the PO submission email so AP can match and expedite invoicing.
3) Once DocuSign is completed (we will countersign within 24 hrs), confirm the PO number here and we'll route the activation to platform-provisioning.

If your procurement needs a formal purchase order acceptance from our side (signed PO acknowledgment), we can generate it but there may be an additional step for SA approvals — let us know if that is required.

I'll upload the short security note to the SOC2 folder now.

Marissa Cole
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[Signed on behalf of Redwood Inference]
